scope: Target-free REA managed static inspection of shipped sprite/font generator artifacts for MMR-416.
limitations: No generated sprite/font output or dynamic dependency resolution was tested.

FontAtlas is native, so managed inspection establishes identity/non-managed classification only; its CLI/API remains unresolved.

findings.boundary: Program.Main calls SpriteEditorDomain.Start and then Console.ReadKey. This is a CLI with an interactive terminal wait, not a demonstrated unattended executable contract. No no-pause switch appears in inspected parameter parser.

findings.parameter_resolution: Raw signature valuetype:32 is TypeDefOrRef coded index 32 -> TypeDef row 8 (SpriteEditorDomainConfiguration).
findings.finding: The executable's own Start call provides a concrete library route that avoids its trailing Console.ReadKey. Start dispatches through TWParallel.ForWithoutRenderThread to per-module work. No target assembly was loaded or invoked.

Tick calls sprite import/generation, packing, SaveSpriteSheets and SaveSpriteSheetData. SaveSpriteSheetData calls SaveSpriteSheetDataAsXml. SaveSheet calls image-writing paths selected by SingleChannel/NoAlphaChannel. SaveSpriteSheets calls EmptyDirectory, so output-directory containment must be verified before adapter execution.
findings.observed_limit_message: The file has too much folder depth. Maximum allowed is 8.
unknowns: Actual generated PNG/XML correctness and game reload are unexecuted.
Whole UI-resource authoring coverage is not established.

findings.finding: Pinned SDK already loads the shipped library, constructs configuration and calls SpriteEditorDomain.Start from a subprocess PowerShell script. It selects SingleModule, chooses output type, then forces GC/finalizers. Source asserts generated file streams otherwise remain unflushed and runs against a private staged module copy.
findings.boundary: ReadKey and library signature are independently corroborated by shipped CIL. Stream-finalizer behavior and runtime generation are source-author assertions, not reproduced by this audit.

findings.finding: REA found x86_64 native PE with no CLI data directory; managed metadata and CIL unavailable. No adjacent FontAtlas DLL appeared in exact-name directory listing. No native session opened and no claim that it is GUI-only or that a CLI exists.

literals.value: If no parameters are given, this program will generate sprite sheets for all modules under your Modules folder.
It can be the path of Modules folder OR it can be path of a single module (i.e. Launcher). This has to be full path.
Single Module is used for standalone projects like launcher. AllAvailableModules is used for general sprite sheet generation.
Output directory modifier. For Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord, Engine is used. For launcher, Standalone is used.

limitations: Metadata tokens are build-local coordinates and are only meaningful with the reported artifact SHA-256 and MVID.
CIL instruction anchors are decoded from file-backed method bodies only; no target assembly is loaded or executed.
Exported types are reported from ExportedType rows as declared; forwarded types are not resolved in their implementing assemblies.
User strings are the #US literals loaded by ldstr in the inspected method bodies, with their own coverage; instruction anchors and normalized CIL digests keep their build-local tokens.

Member signatures decode ECMA-335 primitive, class, valuetype, generic instantiation, generic variable, pointer, byref, single-dimension and general array, function pointer, custom modifier, and typed reference forms; class and valuetype operands keep their encoded TypeDefOrRefOrSpec values, and unsupported forms such as vararg sentinels retain raw signature hashes.
